scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts._comment:pre-hooks: apps/* and the integration tests import @eiaaw/shared by package name, which resolves to its built dist. On a clean checkout there is no dist, so every type crossing that boundary silently degrades to `any` and tsc reports two dozen errors that all trace back to one missing build. npm runs these automatically before the matching script, so a fresh clone and CI behave like a warm working tree.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
